title: Spot Checks to Ensure Drivers of Commercial Vehicles Hold Valid Driving Licences
what_it_is: Spot Checks to Ensure Drivers of Commercial Vehicles Hold Valid Driving Licences

sections.label: Foreign commercial drivers without licences
sections.summary: Checks on commercial vehicle drivers occur on public roads, with an average of 270 foreign motorists yearly found driving without a valid licence, rising 47% to 292 cases in 2024.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Instead, checks of commercial vehicle drivers, including foreign drivers, are conducted on public roads during patrol operations.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: In the past five years, an average of 270 foreign motorists per year were found to have been driving a commercial vehicle without a valid driving licence.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: In 2024, there was a spike in the number of cases by 47%, to 292 cases.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: TP is concerned about this trend, and has been stepping up its enforcement and public education efforts.

sections.label: Enforcement and employer engagement efforts
sections.summary: TP works with MOM and industry stakeholders, reminding employers that penalties apply to those who employ or permit unlicensed drivers, and will enhance enforcement and outreach.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: Indeed, TP has already been working with the Ministry of Manpower (MOM) on this issue and will continue to do so, such as through tapping on their outreach channels and also engaging industry stakeholders, such as those in the food delivery and goods delivery sectors.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: This is regardless of whether it is the driver or the employer of the driver who committed the offence, because the penalties that are upon the driver also apply to any person who employs or permits another person to drive a motor vehicle on the road without a valid licence.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: So, we continue to engage the employers and also would want to remind them that at the end of the day, it is about road safety as well.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: We are very concerned about this spike, so we will continue to engage the community, the stakeholders and at the same time, enhance our enforcement efforts and in reaching out to the people.
